claim_scope.application: Актуальность информационной основы компетенций для кадровой безопасности
claim_scope.events: controlled artificial changes; not real release deltas
claim_scope.allowed_inference: fixed measured workload suite; timing uncertainty conditional on this suite

primary_domain.registry: stable set of all available queries in each family
primary_domain.event_manifest: must be frozen before holdout retrieval; not generated in E02
primary_domain.changes: insert/delete/fragment or text-vector replacement/applicability/text-version; exact counts and valid trace to freeze before final
primary_domain.rates: report actual changed-fragment and applicable-document denominators; no silent percentage rounding

secondary_domains: near ties and high influence fraction
large scale only after obtaining suitable data

correctness.tie_break: UTF-8 fragment_id within document; UTF-8 doc_id across documents

baselines.resource_reference_b_star: fastest complete conforming exact baseline by equal-family geometric total cost on validation; deterministic ID tie-break; frozen before final
baselines.specialized_availability_meaning: Full primary texts, pinned author code and adaptation specification available; no implementation validated against A contract
baselines.selection_policy: one variant per family frozen on validation before final; keep all exploratory results

primary_metric.name: T_total
primary_metric.timing: direct monotonic wall clock of complete lifecycle, not sum of nested timers
primary_metric.ready_vectors_only: secondary metric, never substituted for full lifecycle
primary_metric.criterion: simultaneous one-sided upper bound for R_b <= 0.90 for EVERY mandatory exact baseline
primary_metric.threshold_basis: Prospective engineering target; no enterprise SLA or measured noise asserted. 10% total saving must survive full accounting and uncertainty.

aggregation.scientific_reporting_unit: SOC family with its complete workload history
aggregation.within_family: equal weights to predeclared cases; average paired log cost ratios
aggregation.across_families: equal weights to family log ratios; exponentiate

uncertainty.scope: measurement uncertainty conditional on fixed suite, NOT sampling uncertainty across independent datasets
uncertainty.design: paired complete timing blocks with randomized method order; preserve within-block dependence across methods/cases
uncertainty.resampling_unit: complete timing block, not individual requests or documents
uncertainty.method: paired block bootstrap of equal-family mean log ratios; exponentiated percentile limits
uncertainty.multiplicity: Bonferroni one-sided alpha/m; m = number of mandatory baseline contrasts frozen before final
uncertainty.final_timing_block_count: choose using development pilot precision and freeze BEFORE final; no optional stopping on final
uncertainty.pilot_precision_requirement: central two-sided 95% interval relative half-width <=0.05 of estimated ratio for each primary contrast
uncertainty.precision_not_met: extend pilot by preregistered E05 rule or return inconclusive; keep effect threshold unchanged

constraints.budget_basis: research budget reserving 8 GiB from installed 24 GiB; not measured free RAM guarantee
constraints.latency_aggregation: per predeclared case; report pooled and worst-family values, no pooling away bad tails
constraints.small_sample_p99: report sample count and maximum; mark p99 precision insufficient where necessary; no tail assurance claim
constraints.zero_or_unresolved_baseline_latency: ratio undefined; fail verification until adequate timer/duration, not divide by epsilon
constraints.resource_thresholds_basis: prospective engineering tolerances, not production SLA

failure_policy.mismatch: invalidate implementation result and return to responsible stage
failure_policy.timeout_oom: retain case with reason and limit; no infinite speedup; primary success not established for incomplete suite
failure_policy.timeout_seconds: must be frozen from pilot before final; not yet measured in E02
failure_policy.unamortized_index: report no break-even inside observed horizon
failure_policy.tradeoff: report Pareto/resource tradeoff; do not label full criterion passed
failure_policy.CI_crosses_0_90: inconclusive for practical target, not automatic proof of disadvantage

personnel_metrics.information_freshness: time from acceptance of complete raw batch to current snapshot readiness, including required embeddings
personnel_metrics.incorrect_reuse_rate: wrong reused outputs / all reused outputs; NA if denominator zero
personnel_metrics.Recall_changed_at_k: NA until independently labeled G and covers(fragment, requirement); NA when G empty; not replaced by self-generated labels

holdout.if_exposed_and_adapted: new independent confirmation required; old final becomes exploratory

before_final_freeze_required: primary review completed in E02; recheck if new closer literature or method scope change
method and all baseline implementations pass common contract
exact event trace/case list and seeds
full lifecycle timing boundary and repeatability
fixed timing repetitions and timeout from pilot
new input hashes after any rework

review_provenance.reason_for_panel_change: Verified Yi adaptive reserve, Simpfer and later Simpfer++; explicit strong composition; no performance outcomes used
